founders.founder_bio:
Matt is the co-founder and CTO of Inflection Space Systems. 

Before Inflection, Matt was at Loft Orbital helping them scale up their satellite integration and test by implementing new technologies and automation. Before that, he spent 4 years at Rocket Lab building out their space systems division, most notably shepherding the Lunar Photon spacecraft to the Moon. 

Matt holds a BS and MS degree in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Colorado Boulder.

launches.title: Inflection Space Systems - Hyperscaling Spacecraft Manufacturing (>10,000/year)
launches.tagline: Inflection Space Systems is mass manufacturing standardized spacecraft, and will manufacture 10,000 spacecraft per year by 2031.
launches.body:
**TL;DR: Mass manufacturing spacecraft using robots and terrestrial parts**

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NzVGaRsKhVs>

At Inflection we are developing the industrial capacity to manufacture tens of thousands of spacecraft per year. Imagine a factory that looks more like an Amazon fulfillment center than a NASA-style clean room.

**The Problem**

There is a massive disparity between (1) humanity’s plans for space and (2) the manufacturing reality in the space sector. **The human race has made about 30,000 spacecraft, _ever_**. Next-gen space constellations like orbital data centers, Golden Dome, lunar infrastructure, and global D2D connectivity will **require _hundreds of thousands_ of spacecraft** to become reality. There are actual FCC filings for over 1M spacecraft. **Inflection was founded to bridge this 970,000-spacecraft gap.**

**What We’re Doing**

1. **Immediate vertical integration** of the entire spacecraft hardware and software stack. We are designing everything in-house, to ensure all parts are designed for low-cost and high-volume manufacturing. We’ve already built >50% of the stack, including our own flight software and ground software.
2. **Automating everything.** Now is a great time to build processes, both digital and physical, that use AI and automation. Everything in our factory from supply chain management to metal cutting to testing will be AI-native and will utilize industrial robotics.
3. **Going to space!** We have booked our first launch for Q1 2028 and are actively booking payload customers.

**Who we are**

Alex and Matt have spent their entire careers designing, building, and operating spacecraft (Rocket Lab, Millennium Space Systems, Planet Labs, and Loft Orbital). They’ve conducted classified government missions (REDACTED), facilitated in-space manufacturing (with Varda), and even sent something to the Moon (Lunar Photon). We have first hand experience with how slow, expensive, and antiquated manufacturing is in the space sector, and we’re going to fix it.
